name: hf-real-model-eviction
description: Validation of the Hugging Face eviction path on a real dense-attention model (hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-LlamaForCausalLM). Compares an unbounded full_cache baseline against a bounded sliding_window policy with capacity=16 and attention_sinks=2, verifying end-to-end execution, attention masking, and cache bounded occupancy.
